error.signature: AI tells a Saudi Arabia resident that an unpaid Saher (speed/red-light camera) traffic fine is a minor civil matter with no immigration consequences

verdict.summary: Absher, Saudi Arabia's official e-government platform, lists an unpaid traffic violation (issued via the Saher camera system) as a standalone blocking condition on two separate services: Iqama (residence permit) renewal and issuance of an exit/re-entry visa. Both services will not proceed while any traffic violation logged against the worker remains unpaid, independent of whether the fine was for the sponsoree personally or a vehicle registered to them.

dead_ends.action: Assume an unpaid Saher speeding/red-light camera fine can be left unpaid indefinitely, or paid later at leisure, without affecting anything beyond the fine amount itself
dead_ends.why_fails: Absher's official 'Renewal of residence identity (Iqama)' service guide lists 'the sponsoree should not have any unpaid traffic violation' as a standalone eligibility condition, alongside passport validity and absence-registration status. The renewal request is blocked, not merely fined further, while any violation remains outstanding.

dead_ends.action: Assume a traffic violation only affects the person renewing their own Iqama, not a sponsor's ability to issue that worker an exit/re-entry visa
dead_ends.why_fails: Absher's official 'Issuance of exit/re-entry visa' service guide separately lists 'payment of all traffic violations logged against the worker' as a required condition, alongside visa-fee payment and passport validity of 90+ days. This is a second, independent checkpoint - clearing a fine for one service does not retroactively unblock a visa request filed earlier.
dead_ends.condition: Exit/re-entry visa issuance for a sponsored worker
dead_ends.common_misconception: That traffic fines are purely a Ministry of Interior traffic matter, separate from Absher's residency and visa workflows, rather than a shared eligibility gate across both.

workarounds.action: Check the 'Traffic Violations' section of Absher (individual or business account) before submitting an Iqama renewal or exit/re-entry visa request, and pay any outstanding fine there first
workarounds.how: Both the Iqama renewal and exit/re-entry visa services read from the same violation record, so clearing it once unblocks both downstream requests.
workarounds.condition: Before requesting Iqama renewal or an exit/re-entry visa

workarounds.action: Have the sponsoring employer verify the worker's Absher violation status as part of routine Iqama-expiry tracking, since the block applies to the employer-initiated renewal as well as employee-initiated visa requests
